quote: Why do we keep searching for light, when darkness is where we learn to see? We spend our fleeting days chasing shadows, terrified of the quiet spaces inside. But peace was never found in the noise. It waits quietly beneath your heaviest fears. So let the night gently take you over. The stars only shine when everything else fades.
